basic_info.description: Located in an Iconic mid-century building, this unit offers an intimate experience of the ever-changing, views of the San Francisco Bay.  Spanning from the Golden Gate Bridge/Alcatraz to the North and the Bay Bridge/SF to the south, the panorama is captivating from sunrise to sunset.  With a modern open floor plan, this living space is well suited for entertaining or everyday living.    The outdoor balcony is a perfect place to enjoy morning coffee and evening beverages.  The primary bedroom features custom closets with great storage space and ensuite bath with a Jazuzzi tub.  The south facing guest bedroom enjoys forever City skyline Views.  A stunning bathroom with a large shower and designer finishes complete this home.   This doorman building features on-site management, 24 hr security, laundry facilities on every floor, outdoor swimming pool, community room, BBQs, guest parking and additional storage.  Ideal location near Fort Mason, Aquatic Park, Ghirardelli Square and the Marina Green.  A short stroll to the many great restaurants and boutiques of Polk, Chestnut and Union Streets, shopping and transportation.  Perfect city dwelling or Pied-a-Terre.
